overview: The Imperial Barracks house the elite serpent legions of Ssraeshza.
details: Shissar soldiers train in cursed pits, drillmasters enforce venom‑bound discipline, and imperial smiths forge weapons infused with serpent magic. The Warmaster commands all military operations.
hooks: A venom‑forged weapon destabilizes, releasing cursed energy.
Imperial soldiers mobilize for a purge.
A drillmaster begins a brutal training ritual.
The Warmaster calls the legions to war.
